# Technical documentation — screener
Annex IV of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, for the AI system this profile defines. Generated by
`jaato-scaffold new dossier --profile screener`.
> **This is a skeleton, not a compliance document.** The sections marked *Computed* are facts about the
installed framework, read from the same helpers `jaato-scaffold explain` reads. Everything else is the
provider's to write, and the framework leaves it marked rather than blank.
> *Computed from the installed framework at commit `070c376` on 2026-09-18. Regenerate after any release
or profile change; a stale computed section is worse than an absent one, because it reads as current.*
## 1. General description of the AI system
### Declared under `regulatory:`
| Field | Declared |
| `intended_purpose` | Pre-screen inbound support tickets and draft a reply for a human agent to approve
before it is sent. |
| `interacts_with_persons` | True |
| `provider` | {'name': 'Acme Support GmbH', 'contact': 'compliance@acme.example'} |
| `risk_class` | limited |
### Model bindings
| Tier | Provider | Model |
| (initial) | echo | echo |
### Framework versions
- `jaato-sdk` 0.23.0
- `jaato-server` 0.16.0
> **TODO — the framework cannot supply this.** Annex IV(1) also asks for the system's intended purpose
in prose, the persons or groups it is intended to be used on, the hardware it runs on, and how it is
placed on the market.
> Left in rather than omitted: an absent section in a legal document reads as *nothing to declare*.
## 2. Detailed description of the elements of the system and of the process for its development
### Components and who supplied each
This profile declares no plugins, so the session runs the minimal framework set (permission,
reliability, lifecycle).
Both jaato distributions are licensed `BUSL-1.1`, which is source-available and **not** free and
open-source — so Article 25(4)'s carve-out does not apply and its first sentence does. The component
information pack is `jaato-scaffold new dossier --component`.
> **TODO — the framework cannot supply this.** Annex IV(2) also asks for the development process, design
choices and their rationale, the training methodology and data where the provider trains a model (jaato
trains none), and the human-oversight measures' design rationale.
> Left in rather than omitted: an absent section in a legal document reads as *nothing to declare*.
## 3. Detailed information about the monitoring, functioning and control of the system
